payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into methods for recovering from noisy entity linking in query generation for knowledge base question answering.

claims.text: The SubQG approach can effectively handle noisy entity/relation linking results, achieving stable performance even with limited training data.
Despite a decline in precision due to noise, correct answers can still be generated in 85% of cases when using top-5 candidates from a joint linking system.
Utilizing multiple networks to learn predictors for different query substructures allows for stable performance with noisy linking results.
